svg.desc: The tracking chart and what it depends on: 5 nodes, 4 connections. 2 charts and the 4 dependencies they declare, imported from a Helm chart folder. An arrow points from a chart to a chart it depends on, labelled with the version it gets; a dashed one is switched off in values.yaml. Nodes: - tracking (Chart 0.4.0, app 1.8.2), service - parcelpoint-common (Library chart 0.2.0), service - postgresql (Chart), database - rabbitmq (Chart), queue - cache (Chart redis, off in values), cache Connections: - tracking to postgresql: 15.5.20 - tracking to rabbitmq: 14.6.6 - tracking to cache (dashed): 19.6.4 - tracking to parcelpoint-common: 0.2.0
